description: Mesh a design with GD Structured or GD Unstructured. Standard CGNS export by default; explicit GD CGNS, .msh or OpenFOAM exports. Memory-limited compute: usually a few minutes and under 2 credits; estimate_cost gives the figure. Not needed when an owned mesh for the same geometry and settings already exists and the user accepts reuse. Create a new mesh job per request with a fresh idempotency key. Reuse old compute only when the user requests or accepts reuse. Re-meshing a surface within 24 hours is a retry; on retry_not_allowed ask the user. Same-job transport recovery keeps its key; a reviewed new attempt uses reviewed_job_id and a fresh key. Default retry_policy=review stops after one full attempt; do not silently retry a completed or failed mesh. A verified count miss returns awaiting_decision; report evidence and use review_job to accept/discard, or obtain explicit authority before new compute. Use this job's mesh_cgns for views. For a generic view use view_mesh or the default interactive 3D browser viewer (cell surfaces, quality metrics, true slices); PNGs or 2D sections alone are insufficient. Mesh an owned ready geometry artifact. Structured requests select engine=structured; generic unstructured requests prefer engine=octree_prism when configured; export_formats selects files independently of the engine. Default [cgns] delivers Standard CGNS NGON/NFACE. Preserve an explicit format choice. get_job.mesh_exports identifies the primary downloadable artifact; retain mesh_cgns for views and Fluxcore simulation. All engines default to ±30% cell-count tolerance; omit cell_count_tolerance unless the user asks for another. get_request_schema(mesh) has the full schema; inspect_mesh_geometry gives bounds and assessed component IDs when available. Before an octree mesh, check_geometry finds holes and other surface problems, and plan_mesh shows the sizes, predicted cells and any refusal, without compute. Solid-only uses structured.workflow=solid and flow_region={kind: solid, component_id: inspected ID}; no fluid box is required. Never switch solid/internal/external/CHT intent to bypass a failure. Ask about consequential preferences such as stair_step/cut_cell and boundary layers; otherwise use disclosed best judgment. For an external octree mesh, state intent in octree_prism.controls (flow, wake, layers) and leave sizes out unless the user gives them: the mesher resolves the rest from the geometry, and other octree fields override what it resolves. get_mesh_controls lists surface, volume/wake, layer, topology and boundary settings. Structured has no prism layers; octree controls.boundary_layer.layers=0 and openfoam.n_prism_layers=0 disable layers. For an already-enclosed fluid STL or STEP surface, use octree_prism.workflow=internal with explicit geometry bounds, minimum/maximum spacing and at least one prism layer; cht_ports are points near flat inlet/outlet faces. It meshes only the enclosed fluid and keeps its boundary; MRF zones are not supported. Optional internal_small_feature_size is an explicit meter-valued cutoff for removing tiny disconnected boundary shells, including solid islands; disclose this geometry simplification and keep it omitted unless requested or accepted. A disconnected fluid source is refused by default; internal_component_policy=largest_connected explicitly keeps its largest fluid volume and reports excluded pockets, while refusing nested cavity shells or ambiguous equal volumes. Octree CHT needs the STEP's actual material names and an explicit n_prism_layers: 0 for the octree CHT route, more for prism layers on the coolant walls (a fluid region named with fluid or coolant, and cht_ports near the inlet and outlet; sizes are absolute). Meshing admission is memory limited. Record assumptions in decision_context. At most 50 million cells. Use artifact summaries to inspect patches/zones before simulation. Each person runs one meshing job at a time; a further one waits, and its queue.message says why: tell the user rather than resubmitting. Returns a job ID; may incur compute charges.

DecisionContext.description: User intent and declared assumptions, retained with the owned job request.

component_id.description: Existing native profile component ID for internal fluid or solid-only meshing; never infer an ID from a display name.

kind.description: external: fluid outside bodies; internal: selected fluid volume; solid: material inside a selected closed component, with no fluid region.

NamedSurface.description: A part of the wall, uploaded as its own STL in the surface's units, for per-part sizes, layers, wakes and patches.

name.description: The part's name in controls and the mesh's wall patch name.

first_height.description: First layer height in metres. Give this or y_plus; with neither the stack is sized to meet the core cells.

gap_compression.description: In narrow passages shrink the stack to fit, keeping its layer count, instead of dropping layers.

layers.description: Prism layers; 0 for none (inviscid or wall-function walls).

y_plus.description: Target first-cell y+; needs flow.speed. A requested y+ is not an achieved one.

OctreeControls.description: Meshing intent: the mesher sizes everything left out for the request's target_cells.

exact_count.description: When the user states a cell count, probe the topology to land within ±10%. Count rebuilds also need retry_policy=automatic; otherwise the first passing mesh is kept and its count reported.

surfaces.description: Size and layer overrides per named surface or glob such as wheel_*.

OctreeDomain.description: Distances from the body in body lengths (unset ones as "standard"), or absolute corners in metres.

bottom.description: Below the body when there is no ground; default as top.

angle_of_attack.description: Degrees, turning the stream from direction towards up. The domain stays aligned with the body axes; the wake follows the stream.

contact_plinth.description: Tyres resting on the ground: cut them just above it and extrude a vertical plinth instead of the tangential wedge.

farfield.description: inlet_outlet: velocity inlet upstream, pressure outlet downstream, symmetry elsewhere. freestream: every outer face a far-field patch (free flight at any angle); a ground stays a moving wall.

ground.description: "none": free stream all round; "body_min": a moving-wall ground touching the lowest point of the body (vehicles); a number: the ground at that up-coordinate in metres.

kinematic_viscosity.description: m^2/s, for y_plus sizing; air by default.

sideslip.description: Degrees, turning the stream towards the side axis.

speed.description: Free-stream speed in m/s; sizes the first layer from boundary_layer.y_plus.

up.description: Up axis, different from the direction's axis.

OctreePartWake.description: A wake behind named parts (mirrors, wheels, a hub), along the stream.

size.description: Cell size in metres; default the body wake's.

OctreePrismOptions.description: GD Unstructured. Get exact sizing, units, layers and rotating-zone controls with get_mesh_controls or get_tool_schema. Unknown fields and quality-gate overrides are rejected.

controls.description: Meshing intent (flow, wake, layers, sizes) for an external mesh. The mesher resolves the domain, spacings and every other field left out from the geometry, with the settings the development meshes were validated with. Other fields given beside it override the resolved values: set them only for a value the user asked for.

named_surfaces.description: Parts of the wall, each an uploaded STL in the surface's units, named for controls.surfaces, wake parts and around regions; each also becomes a wall patch. A STEP's solids are named by the mesher, so leave this out for a STEP.

retry_authorization_reason.description: Explicit user or authorized-agent delegation for bounded automatic mesh retries; required for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: Review stops before another full mesh or memory-escalation attempt and retains eligible out-of-tolerance results for a decision. Automatic allows only the explicitly authorized bounded retry budget, within the credential's retry allowance.

OctreeRegion.description:
Cells inside are no larger than size: a box (minimum and maximum, or center and lengths,
rotated by x_axis and y_axis), a cylinder (start, end, radius), a sphere (center, radius),
or around named surfaces (surfaces, distance).

distance.description: An around region's reach from its surfaces, in metres.

inner_radius.description: An annulus round a hub, or a spherical shell.

lengths.description: Full box lengths along x_axis, y_axis and their cross product.

surfaces.description: Named surfaces for an around region.

OctreeRotatingZone.description: A cylindrical rotating (MRF) cell zone, written to the mesh.

angular_velocity.description: rad/s, when rpm is not given.

size.description: Cell size inside the zone in metres; default none.

OctreeShell.description: Distance from the whole body, with an independently extended downstream reach.

distance.description: Surface distance in body lengths, NOT metres. List shells nearest first.

downstream.description: Downstream reach divided by surface distance. 1 is an equal-distance shell; 4 extends four times farther downstream along controls.flow.direction.

size.description: Cell size in metres; omit for target-count sizing. Outer shells default to 2, 4, 8… times the surface size.

close_gaps.description: Close fluid gaps narrower than this many first-layer heights. Changes the geometry: use only for an explicit simplification and disclose it.

curvature_angle.description: Most surface turning per adaptive edge, in degrees; leave out for the service's setting (18 by default).

fidelity.description: high: sharp edges snapped onto the wall and creases split, so creased walls warp far less, at some cost in the worst cells and up to ~40% more time. standard (older name default): creases chamfered by the cell beside them; faster.

max_deviation.description: Allowed wall-to-CAD p95 deviation in metres; default two surface sizes.

min_size.description: Smallest curvature-driven edge in metres; default size / 8.

preparation.description: auto: feature-preserving remesh for clean solids, a voxel wrap for dirty CAD; preserve or wrap force one route.

size.description: Wall edge length in metres (with adaptive sizing, the largest). Leave out to size the wall for target_cells; set it only when the user fixes a size.

sizing.description: adaptive refines size for curvature, sharp edges, narrow gaps and thin walls down to min_size; uniform keeps one edge length.

layers.description: Most prism layers on these surfaces; 0 for none.

size.description: Largest wall edge on these surfaces, in metres; refines the automatic size there, never coarsens it.

domain.description: Wind-tunnel size around the body (compact 3/6/2/2, standard 5/10/4/4, large 8/16/6/6 body lengths upstream/downstream/side/top), or an explicit domain.

growth.description: How quickly cells coarsen away from the body.

max_size.description: Largest far-field cell in metres; default from the domain size.

shells.description: Nested whole-body surface-distance regions, external flow only; requires mesh_controls_version 2. Count calibration may scale requested sizes.

length.description: Downstream extent in body lengths, along the stream.

levels.description: Nested levels, each twice as long with twice the cell size (2: a near and a far wake).

size.description: Near-wake cell size in metres; default twice the surface size. Leave out so the wake is sized for target_cells.

spread.description: Widening: each side moves out by spread per unit length (0.1: +10% of the length on every side at the end).

OpenFoamOptions.description: engine=openfoam options. Sizing, refinement and quality fields: get_mesh_controls(engine=openfoam) or get_tool_schema. Unknown fields are rejected.

input_unit.description: Surface coordinate units; domain bounds and spacing are always in metres.

n_prism_layers.description: Requested layers; 0 disables layers. Achieved layers/coverage must be checked after meshing.

retry_authorization_reason.description: Explicit user or authorized-agent delegation for bounded automatic mesh retries; required for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: Review stops before another full mesh attempt; automatic allows the explicitly authorized, bounded max_remesh_iterations budget, within the credential's retry allowance.

StructuredInternalSurface.description: Two-sided rectangular pressure-jump selection, never an exterior wall.

StructuredOptions.description: engine=structured options. Sizing, refinement and quality fields: get_mesh_controls(engine=structured) or get_tool_schema. Unknown fields are rejected.

adaptive_refinement.description: CAD assemblies and internal stair-step: resolve sampled thin features and tight passages, with coarser bulk where possible. Geometric sizing does not establish wall-model accuracy.

input_unit.description: Derive from artifact metadata; required for uploads without declared units.

mesh_type.description: Ask about surface fidelity; stair_step is the disclosed default. Neither option extrudes prism layers.

retry_authorization_reason.description: Explicit user or authorized-agent delegation for bounded automatic mesh retries; required for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: Review stops before another full target-count attempt; automatic allows the explicitly authorized bounded max_target_iterations budget, within the credential's retry allowance.

engine.description: structured = Cartesian; octree_prism = native octree/polyhedral with prism layers; openfoam = legacy engine identifier. Prefer configured octree_prism for generic unstructured requests; preserve explicit methods. Choose delivered file formats separately with export_formats.

export_formats.description: Delivered mesh formats, in preference order. Default cgns is Standard CGNS (NGON/NFACE) for ParaView. gd_cgns is GD CGNS for Fluxcore/Studio; fluent is a Fluent-format polyhedral .msh; openfoam is a polyMesh archive. Select formats independently of the meshing engine. The first format is the primary download. GD CGNS is also retained internally for simulation and viewing. Preserve an explicit user choice; do not ask for a format when none was specified.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each newly requested job, even with identical inputs or a matching completed job. Reuse unchanged only for retries/resuming that same intended job. Never replace it to retry an uncertain submission.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL that receives a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.

reviewed_job_id.description: Explicitly requested new attempt after reviewing this completed mesh job, including quality or resource failures. Use a fresh idempotency key; this records lineage and never restarts the prior execution.
